claims.text: ARAML outperforms state-of-the-art text GANs with a more stable training process and better performance metrics.
The incorporation of RAML into adversarial training leads to lower training variance and improved performance on text generation tasks.
Experiments show that ARAML achieves better results in terms of Self-BLEU and stability compared to other GANs.
